parent_context.interpretation: R3 is a forward-time software negative-control. It does not constitute a physical experimental falsification of every retrocausal theory because no retrocausal physical resource was incorporated.

question: Which alternative scientific test could, in principle, identify a genuine intervention-dependent influence of a later free choice on already sealed earlier records, while using ordinary CPU for all statistical computations?

research_sources.name: Theories with no superluminal signaling have greater information-processing power than theories with no superluminal causation
research_sources.claim: Hypothetical no-superluminal-signalling jamming can permit operationally certifiable retrocausal/NSC-violating correlations despite no individually accessible superluminal signalling.
research_sources.limitation: The requisite postquantum physical jamming resource is not demonstrated.

research_sources.name: Experimental violation of a Bell-like causal inequality in a photonic quantum switch
research_sources.claim: Measured causal-order Bell-like inequality value 1.8090 ± 0.0024 vs fixed-order bound 1.75, 24-sigma under the stated assumptions.
research_sources.limitation: Published dataset has 16 conditional probability CSVs, not complete pre/post timestamped detector shot logs. Fair-sampling and other experimental loopholes remain. Not a backward-time message.

research_sources.name: Experimental violation of a Bell-like inequality for causal order
research_sources.claim: Photonic quantum switch inequality violation 5.7 standard deviations.
research_sources.limitation: Not loophole free; demonstrated indefinite causal order differs from operational future-to-past bit transfer.

research_sources.name: Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping
research_sources.claim: Four-photon experiment, earlier registered photons, late independent QRNG selectable measurement in timelike future.
research_sources.limitation: Later sorted entanglement correlations do not change unconditional early log. No physical message read in past.

research_sources.name: Retrocausal Capacity of a Quantum Channel: Communicating through Noisy Closed Timelike Curves
research_sources.claim: Mathematical capacities of hypothetical noisy postselected CTC communication channels characterized.
research_sources.limitation: Assumes a CTC-like physical resource not demonstrated. Postselection of ordinary data alone is not a message back in time.

research_sources.name: Forward-time equivalent of a retrocausal diffusion hidden-variable model for quantum mechanics
research_sources.claim: One proposed future-boundary stochastic retrocausal model has equivalent forward-time trajectory dynamics.
research_sources.limitation: Future boundary terminology or fitting past+future conditions is insufficient for proof of real retrocausal action.

research_sources.name: Public distributed randomness from drand Quicknet
research_sources.claim: Public cryptographically verifiable BLS threshold beacon can be selected by future round before release and independently checked afterwards.
research_sources.limitation: Cryptographic unpredictability is assumption-dependent; SHA256(signature) 256 bits aren't 256 independently certified hardware random events. Timing of GitHub early record still needs independent attestation.

research_sources.name: Event-Ready Bell Test Using Entangled Atoms Simultaneously Closing Detection and Locality Loopholes
research_sources.claim: Restored public original experimental data may permit secondary event-time analyses with ordinary CPU.
research_sources.limitation: Reanalysis alone cannot create an A-before-B experiment if the original apparatus did not impose that ordering; inspect raw field schema and genuine time ordering first.

research_sources.name: Experimental quantum key distribution in an indefinite causal order
research_sources.claim: Open dataset plus Python scripts support independent CPU reproduction of reported quantum-switch-derived results.
research_sources.limitation: Authors say postselection is required; this is not a physical channel to earlier receiver.

prioritized_program.role: Strongest immediate all-CPU methodological upgrade to seal an early prediction before an independent future public beacon and verify later target externally.
prioritized_program.explicit_negative_control: Early 256-bit SHA256 hash control. NOT the previously trained JANUS model, not a validated predictive algorithm. Future model performance would require a separately preregistered trained-model cohort.

prioritized_program.role: Verify mathematical causal-inequality results from Qu et al Dryad and Valibouse et al Zenodo with CPUs, including published fair-sampling limitations.
prioritized_program.action: Reproduce probability normalization, uncertainty and predeclared inequalities. If raw individual photonic time tags unavailable, do not assert A-before-B chronology.

prioritized_program.role: Find lab data/authorized access where early A detector record is externally sealed before QRNG B and every attempt, including missing detector clicks, is included.
prioritized_program.action: Preregister single-trial chronology, all-attempt statistical analysis and independent replication; compare local marginals as well as early joint witness without late-herald postselection.

prioritized_program.role: Study mathematical constraints and noise tolerance of postquantum jamming/process-matrix/CTC proposals on CPU.
prioritized_program.action: Require candidate to predict an operationally measurable difference from all forward-time quantum/CPTP and classical-leak models; otherwise keep MATHEMATICAL_ONLY.

non_negotiable_proof_gates.G1: Real earlier record A available to receiver before independent B generated, with outside timestamp/seal audited.
non_negotiable_proof_gates.G2: All original scheduled trials retained, including detector no-clicks, abortions and losses, without future-conditioned selection.
non_negotiable_proof_gates.G3: Independent late entropy and causal isolation, verified choice B not supplied to A or its predictor through seed, scheduling or network.
non_negotiable_proof_gates.G4: Predeclared algorithm, effect threshold, fixed N and all multiple-testing penalties before target results.
non_negotiable_proof_gates.G5: Independent physical replication and explicit intervention-dependence; mathematical correlation alone is not retrocausal proof.
non_negotiable_proof_gates.G6: Only after G1-G5 may a concrete physical retrocausal interpretation be proposed; the transmission carrier would still need separate evidence.

conclusion: NO_PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED_RETROCAUSAL_CHANNEL; external signed future beacon is the strongest immediate CPU-only improvement to challenge design, while quantum-switch and Bell data are separate complementary lines.
